---
title: "Overleaf"
---

Overleaf is the lowest-effort way to start: it runs in the browser, so there is
nothing to install, and two people can edit the same document at once. The
trade is control — you work through its interface rather than your own
keybindings, and you cannot customise much.

The [Overleaf guide](../overleaf/index.qmd) covers signing up, the editor,
collaborating, templates, and bibliographies.
